Quad9’s official retirement notice says its JSON service on port 5053 was retired May 5, 2025 and directs users to standards-based DoH on port 443: https://quad9.net/news/blog/quad9-json-based-dns-service-retires-5-may-2025/ . Current docs list https://dns.quad9.net/dns-query: https://docs.quad9.net/services/ .
